snippet.title: Sacred Tears TRUE - Opening Trailer
snippet.description:
Sacred Tears TRUE is available on Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/316840/

For more information, visit the Sacred Tears TRUE homepage at: http://SacredTearsTrue.com


Sacred Tears TRUE is a doujin RPG which blends the best of the JRPG genre with innovative and fun game elements, plus high quality art and music in one honest-to-goodness gem of a game.

Story:
Seil and his childhood friend Seana are neophyte thieves in the Thieves Guild of Genoseed City. By day they operate a private investigator agency, and by night they undertake Thieves Guild missions across the city. Sacred Tears TRUE is the story of these young thieves and their pursuit of dreams and adventure.

Features: 
• Quite simply one of the best ever doujin RPG and a must-have for any JRPG fan!
• Fresh and engaging characters, stories, and emotion -- from comedy to political intrigue.
• Traditional and new JRPG features, including a unique card battle system, redistributable skill points, and multiway system!
• Huge volume and outstanding replay value: 24 main story chapters and 24 side chapters
• Short-form chapters (5--30 mins each) for easy play!
• A treasure trove of beautiful, high quality character art!
• An exceptional original soundtrack!

For more details, please visit the Sacred Tears TRUE homepage at http://SacredTearsTrue.com

★★★ Sacred Tears True ★★★

Created by AlphaNuts
Localized & published by Nyu Media
